purpose: Track the public-documentation and snapshot lifecycle of the three historical Subtype_evDir columns.

december_public_readme.observation: The 2025-12-18 public README schema documents 21 Point_data columns and does not document the three historical Subtype_evDir columns.

later_zenodo.observation: The later Zenodo snapshot still has 24 columns but does not contain Subtype_evDir_x/y/z; its schema uses renamed type/hemisphere/metric fields and adds Area_2d.

proven: The three Subtype_evDir columns are present in the December 2025 binary artifact.
They were not part of the 21-column Point_data schema documented in the public December 18 README snapshot.
They are absent from the later August 2026 Zenodo point_data schema.
conclusion.interpretation: This lifecycle is consistent with legacy/internal or transitional analysis fields that were later removed or replaced. It narrows the search target toward historical analysis code rather than the final public Metrics1 notebook.
